note: Card data for Mega Shine (B2b), which TCGdex does not have. Rules text and stats as shown by the Limitless TCG Pocket card database (pocket.limitlesstcg.com); rarity and booster packs from the open dataset pokemon-tcg-pocket-database (MIT).
